summary: Complete Smart Waste Segregation & Recycling System built entirely in pure HTML + CSS + Vanilla JavaScript. No React, no Babel, no build step. Only external dependency is Chart.js (CDN) for charts. Features: animated hero section, intro cards, live dashboard, AI waste detection with drag-and-drop upload, color-coded bins, statistics charts, interactive sorting simulation with confetti, classification history with filters, toast notifications, mobile-responsive navbar.
